en: Well, Aryna,
great to have you back here in Toronto
and you had to be at your best tonight,
a tough opening round match for you,
but you're through, how do you assess
your performance after tonight?
Yeah, not an easy match, after a little break,
super happy to be through and happy
to be back in Toronto
and see you all tonight, it was amazing,
thank you, thank you so much.
We love having you back,
I wanted to ask you about your break,
you went to Vienna with Ash,
your Cavalier King Charles Spaniel,
with your fiancé Georgios,
to have a little break from tennis,
are you feeling refreshed,
are you feeling ready
for the hard court season?
I went to Vienna before Wimbledon,
then I went to Mykonos after Wimbledon,
so there was much needed,
there was so much needed, I feel refreshed,
recharged and ready to go.
Great stuff, listen, your hard court record
has been phenomenal this year,
24 victories out of 25, do you feel you're
your best here on the hard court,
are you feeling really comfortable playing
back on the hard court?
I feel definitely happy to be back
on hard court this season.
